name: file-watcher
description: Notice added, modified and removed files in allowed directories by polling: snapshot to a cursor, list changes since a cursor, or wait (up to 5 minutes) for the next change; bounded, never follows symlinks

nodes.title: Snapshot a directory
nodes.description: Records the files and directories (type, size, modified time) under a directory inside the allowed directories and returns a cursor for list_changes or wait_for_change

path.description: Directory inside FILE_WATCHER_ALLOWED_DIRS (absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first one)

max_depth.description: How deep to look (1 = only the directory's own entries)

include_hidden.description: Include names starting with a dot

name_pattern.description: Only track entries whose name matches this glob (* and ?), e.g. *.csv; at most 256 characters

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List changes since a cursor
nodes.description: Rescans the directory of a cursor and lists what was added, modified or removed since it was taken, with a new cursor

cursor.description: Cursor from snapshot, list_changes or wait_for_change

max_changes.description: Most changes to return; `changes_truncated` says when there were more

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Wait for a change
nodes.description: Polls a directory (or a cursor's directory) until something is added, modified or removed, or until timeout_seconds (at most 300) pass; returns the changes and a new cursor either way

path.description: Directory inside FILE_WATCHER_ALLOWED_DIRS (absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first one)

cursor.description: Wait for changes since this cursor (changes already made since it are returned at once); otherwise the wait starts now

max_depth.description: How deep to look (1 = only the directory's own entries)

include_hidden.description: Include names starting with a dot

name_pattern.description: Only track entries whose name matches this glob (* and ?), e.g. *.csv; at most 256 characters

max_changes.description: Most changes to return; `changes_truncated` says when there were more

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
